results.title: California voters to decide on Proposition 39's proposed voter ID requirements
results.description: California voters will decide Tuesday whether to change how the state verifies the identity of voters under Proposition 39, which proposes new identification requirements for both in-person and mail-in voting.

results.title: Number of new U.S. citizens who can vote has doubled since 2000
results.description: The number of naturalized U.S. citizens who can vote is up twofold since 2000, with the figure representing 5.5% of Utah's pool of voters as of 2024.

results.title: California's Prop. 45 would make changes to environmental review process in construction
results.description: California's environmental review process for construction projects could undergo major changes under a ballot measure being considered by voters in the November election.

results.title: US Halts Military Aid to Israel After $4 Billion Deal With Netanyahu
results.description: President Donald Trump confirms a deal with Benjamin Netanyahu to end US military aid to Israel by year-end, citing reduced need and political strategy while outlining future conditional support.

results.title: California Congressional District 4 voters to choose between incumbent Mike Thompson, challenger Eric Jones
results.description: Voters are deciding between two Democrats running to represent the state's 4th Congressional District — longtime Rep. Mike Thompson and political newcomer Eric Jones, who is a nonprofit executive and venture capitalist.

results.title: Trump says Israel will stop receiving $4B in US aid by year's end, can still buy weapons
results.description: President Donald Trump says Benjamin Netanyahu raised the idea of ending $4 billion in U.S. military aid to Israel by the end of the year.

results.title: Trump Announces He's Ending U.S. Aid to Israel: 'They Don't Need It'
results.description: President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that he will end military aid to Israel at the end of the year.
